Any system-admin authentication, successful or failed. This surface grants cross-organization powers including irreversible user deletion, and authenticates with a SHARED static password (F-056), so there is no per-actor attribution — every use deserves a human look.

Expected to be low volume. If it is noisy, that itself is the finding.

**First response:** correlate the IP and user-agent on the audit row against who was legitimately working. A failure burst means the shared password is being guessed, and it has no rate limit (F-097).
